data.body: CHECKPOINT 4/6: Implementation complete ✓ — Added 5 helper functions to plugins/dso/hooks/lib/merge-helpers.sh: _pr_repo (owner/repo cache), _pr_fetch_unresolved_threads, _pr_thread_is_unresolved, _pr_post_thread_reply, _pr_resolve_thread, _pr_settling_check. Also fixed grep-c || echo 0 bug in test file (double-output when file exists with 0 matches). Added test-index entries for both merge-helpers.sh and merge-to-main-pr.sh.
